content_text: Would you shoot it as it were though or were you working under a targeted stop for the scene? IE, if you wanted to shoot at a T2.8 but metered at an 8.0 (depending on camera settings)  would you ND down to get your T2.8? Conversely if you wanted a 5.6 but metered at 2.8 are you bring in your lights to get your desired working stop? I’d be very surprised if you were shooting as it were from the meter.
